text: chromeMeeting.Join: split chromedp.Navigate from pre-join WaitVisible into separate Run steps and validate MeetingURL up front, so navigation failures surface a distinct error from 'pre-join not visible'. Copilot PR#7 follow-up.

Live caption capture: activate captions (More actions -> Language and speech -> Turn on live captions); inject MutationObserver on data-tid=closed-caption-renderer-wrapper with terminal-punctuation dedup; AddBinding(sendCaptionToGo)+ListenTarget bridge; stream to transcript.Writer. Acceptance: TestMeetingEnableCaptions passes.

Audio capture + MP3: getDisplayMedia({audio,video}); isolate audio track; MediaRecorder chunks -> base64 over sendAudioToGo binding; pure-Go MP3 encode (shine-mp3); stream to .mp3. Acceptance: TestMeetingCaptureAudio passes.

Wire the browser.Meeting (Join/EnableCaptions/CaptureAudio) into the join and schedule CLI commands. Currently ChromeRunner only navigates and holds; the join command should drive the full Meeting FSM + caption/audio capture, writing transcript Markdown + MP3 to the configured output dir.

fix(config): CI required-check never reports on backlog/docs-only PRs. ci.yml uses workflow-level paths-ignore (.backlogit, docs, .autoharness, *.md) on the pull_request trigger, so the whole CI workflow (including the 'Detect code changes' job that IS ruleset PR-Required's required status check) is skipped for backlog/docs-only PRs. The required check stays 'expected' forever, permanently BLOCKING such PRs and forcing admin bypass (which fails when bypass_actors is empty). Fix: remove paths-ignore from the pull_request trigger so the 'changes' job always runs and reports 'Detect code changes'; the 'Build, vet, lint & test' job already self-gates via 'if: needs.changes.outputs.code==true' plus the dorny/paths-filter denylist, so it stays skipped for backlog-only diffs. Consider same for push. Removes recurring admin-merge need on staging/closure PRs.

fix(transcript): escape participant-controlled fields in the Markdown transcript writer. Session forwards Teams-controlled speaker/text unchanged and transcript.Writer.WriteEvent interpolates both directly into Markdown, so a crafted display name or caption can inject Markdown/HTML (headings, links) into the rendered transcript. Escape/neutralize speaker and text (and consider caption text) in WriteEvent (or in the capture sink) with regression tests. Low severity (local file, participant-controlled). Surfaced by PR #19 Copilot review.

shine-mp3 unsafe/-race residual risk: its unsafe pointer arithmetic trips -race checkptr and is technically UB even in non-race builds. Contribute a checkptr-safe fix upstream or vendor/replace the MP3 encoder before production audio use. See docs/compound/build-errors/shine-mp3-race-checkptr.md.

Live end-to-end verification of the FSM/caption/audio DOM selectors against a real authenticated Teams meeting. All browser selectors are marked VERIFY LIVE; run the integration harness (GO_TEAMS_INTEGRATION=1, TEAMS_PROFILE_DIR, TEAMS_MEETING_URL) and iterate on selectors/timing until TestMeetingJoin/EnableCaptions/CaptureAudio pass.
